card.name: ISBN digits and product pricing details
card.fires_on: Characters inside or just before an ISBN number (the 978 start, hyphens, the space after ISBN), and punctuation near publisher, distributor or price information in product listings.

modes.label: ISBN numbers
modes.description: The 978 prefix digits, hyphens or the space right after ISBN in book and media listings.

modes.label: Distributor and price info
modes.description: Punctuation or currency signs in listings that name a distributor or give a launch price.
modes.example: Prod. by Listening Library<<.>> Dist. by Listening Library/Books on

card.writes: It pushes toward words about sellers and pricing, such as distributors, dealers and manufacturer, and away from the word series.
card.plain: It fires on book ID numbers and listing details, where the next words are likely to be about who sells the item or its price.
